gloss: sukiyaki pot; shallow iron pot for sukiyaki

definitions.gloss: sukiyaki pot; shallow iron pot for sukiyaki
definitions.explanation: A wide, shallow, heavy iron or cast-iron pot specifically designed for cooking sukiyaki. Its flat bottom and low sides allow ingredients to be simmered in a thin layer of sweet soy-based broth at the table.

examples.english: I put the sukiyaki pot on the heat.

examples.japanese: ⟦{祖母|そぼ}→祖母：00813_sobo⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{鉄|てつ}→鉄：02225_tetsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧すき{焼|や}き{鍋|なべ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}け{継|つ}いだ→受け継ぐ：06700_uketsugu⟧。
examples.english: I inherited an iron sukiyaki pot from my grandmother.

examples.japanese: ⟦お{正月|しょうがつ}→お正月：05586_oshougatsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦いつも→いつも：00599_itsumo⟧⟦{家族|かぞく}→家族：00552_kazoku⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{大|おお}きな→大きな：02849_ookina⟧すき{焼|や}き{鍋|なべ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{囲|かこ}んで→囲む：02037_kakomu⟧⟦{食事|しょくじ}→食事：02087_shokuji⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: At New Year's, our family always gathers around a large sukiyaki pot for a meal.

notes:
Composed of ⟦すき{焼|や}き→すき焼き：10368_sukiyaki⟧ (sukiyaki, a Japanese hot pot dish) and ⟦{鍋|なべ}→鍋：01038_nabe⟧ (pot). The traditional すき{焼|や}き{鍋|なべ} is made of cast iron (⟦{鋳鉄|ちゅうてつ}→鋳鉄：26298_chuutetsu⟧) and has a wide, flat shape that distinguishes it from deeper hot pot vessels.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- すき{焼|や}き{鍋|なべ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{囲|かこ}む→囲む：02037_kakomu⟧: to gather around a sukiyaki pot
- ⟦{鉄|てつ}→鉄：02225_tetsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧すき{焼|や}き{鍋|なべ}: iron sukiyaki pot
- すき{焼|や}き{鍋|なべ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{具材|ぐざい}→具材：06230_guzai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{入|い}れる→入れる：01098_ireru⟧: to add ingredients to the sukiyaki pot

CULTURAL NOTE:
Sukiyaki is traditionally cooked at the table, so the pot is both a cooking vessel and a serving dish. In many families, a well-seasoned cast-iron sukiyaki pot is a treasured kitchen heirloom passed down through generations.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{土鍋|どなべ}→土鍋：07949_donabe⟧: clay pot — used for nabemono (Japanese hot pot), deeper than a sukiyaki pot
- ⟦{鉄鍋|てつなべ}→鉄鍋：23918_tetsunabe⟧: iron pot — general term; the sukiyaki pot is a specific type
- ⟦フライパン→フライパン：01025_furaipan⟧: frying pan — similar shape but different material and purpose
